composition: Brick lock chamber with a low bridge and quay houses · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The lock at Makkum is a brick chamber between the town water and the IJsselmeer, with a bridge across it and brick houses along the quay. The older wooden drawbridge is not the present span. It is overcast, about 12.4°C, with wind near 3.6 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. No hotel name is readable.
